entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Columbus landed on the northern coast of Hispaniola on December 5, 1492, established the short-lived fort La Navidad from the wreck of the Santa María, and on his second voyage founded La Isabela in 1494. Santo Domingo, founded in 1496, became the first permanent European settlement in the Americas.
